facts.value: QTEM (Quantitative Techniques for Economics and Management) is a continuously growing international network of leading universities worldwide. The network is supported by international corporate partners, with Banco Santander being a corporate partner of the department in the QTEM network.
facts.programme_association: Double Degree Master's Program Paris Dauphine-PSL

facts.value: Two options are available: QTEM Track 1: 1 semester abroad + an internship of 240 hours; QTEM Track 2: 2 semesters abroad + an internship of 240 hours.
facts.programme_association: Double Degree Master's Program Paris Dauphine-PSL

facts.value: All QTEM students participate in the QTEM Global Business Analytics Challenge (GBAC, 8 ECTS), which consists of group work on a business case and two preparatory courses that provide soft skills necessary for successful teamwork and case processing.
facts.programme_association: Double Degree Master's Program Paris Dauphine-PSL

facts.value: A total of 50 ECTS points in quantitative courses must be completed, with 22 ECTS points for each semester abroad at one of the QTEM partner universities.
facts.programme_association: Double Degree Master's Program Paris Dauphine-PSL

facts.value: The master's thesis is written at the home university in Frankfurt.
facts.programme_association: Double Degree Master's Program Paris Dauphine-PSL

facts.value: Upon successful completion of the QTEM program and the master's degree of the department, students receive the master's degree from the department as well as a QTEM certificate.
facts.programme_association: Double Degree Master's Program Paris Dauphine-PSL

facts.value: A prerequisite for participation in the QTEM program is proof of a GMAT test result of at least 555 points or an equivalent GRE result (e.g. 155 in Verbal Reasoning and 159 in Quantitative Reasoning).
facts.programme_association: Double Degree Master's Program Paris Dauphine-PSL

facts.value: A new GMAT test format was introduced starting from the fourth quarter of 2024. The previous format will still be accepted with a minimum score of 600 required.
facts.programme_association: Double Degree Master's Program Paris Dauphine-PSL

facts.value: The QTEM exchange takes place in the 3rd and/or 4th semester.
facts.programme_association: Double Degree Master's Program Paris Dauphine-PSL

facts.value: Students in the first semester of the master's programs Business Administration (BWL), Management Science (Mgmt Sc.), Money, Macro and Finance (MMF), and International Economics and Economic Policy (MIEEP) can apply.
facts.programme_association: Double Degree Master's Program Paris Dauphine-PSL

facts.value: The application deadline for the academic year 2026/27 ends on February 1, 2026.
